name: jev-browser-control
description: Let Claude drive a real Chrome window: open pages, read them, click, type and fill in forms. Jev, a fast decision model, runs whole multi-step tasks at about half a second and a fraction of a cent per step, paid from your Jev Browser Control credits. Logins you make in the window are kept, and clicks that buy, pay, send, post or delete wait for your OK.

jbc_api_key.title: Jev Browser Control key
jbc_api_key.description: Your jbc_ key from jevbrowsercontrol.com/dashboard. Jev's steps are paid from that account's credits; check your balance and add credits in the dashboard.

ask_before_irreversible.title: Ask before buying, sending, posting or deleting
ask_before_irreversible.description: On: jev_task stops before clicks that buy, pay, send, post or delete, and Claude asks you. Off: such tasks run to the end without asking.
